items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play Sunday vs Jets after limited practice all week following high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Returned to practice this week; sources anticipate activation and return.
items.implication: Boosts Drake Maye and NE passing game; elevates Brown to startable WR despite rust risk.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely due to superficial blood clot. First game without him Sunday.
items.why: Blood clot; information gathering continues, no IR plans.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; healthy top pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks) still viable but QB downgrade.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume stable; avoid long-term IR stash pressure.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.why: ETR Sunday injuries roundup; Rapoport notes another game without him.
items.implication: Huntley starts; downgrade Ravens pass catchers slightly but Flowers still startable.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin with Shipley also out; McKee era starts without top back.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining backs including Gainwell/Pierce.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so expect heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice/injury report parsing; PIT WR depth and PHI personnel notes.
items.implication: Lean start Metcalf in 2-WR; monitor Brown/Henderson closely; PHI pass catchers safer than RBs.
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target share spike in reduced WR sets; Warren Q risk.

items.implication: Worthy and other KC WRs see more targets with Mahomes.
items.opportunity: Target share increase for Xavier Worthy et al.

items.text: DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty listed IN (cleared).
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday injuries IN list.
items.implication: Full roles restored; Smith especially key with Hurts out.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday.
Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams.
items.implication: ARI backfield opens; Allgeier or others elevate.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) again for Sunday vs Patriots.
Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London; ruled out vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Marks or other HOU RBs see expanded role in London.
items.opportunity: Lead back opportunity for HOU backups.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; strong matchup.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone upside vs weak secondary.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ). Hates include Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, JK Dobbins, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: Usage + soft matchups for loves (volume/goal-line for RBs; WSH buffet); tough matchups/QB issues for hates.
items.implication: Start the loves; fade the hates in Week 6 lineups.
items.opportunity: Kyren elite usage; Javonte GL work; London bankable role.

items.text: LOVE Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), notes Hurts OUT/McKee and Saquon status; also Stafford/Love in shootouts.
items.why: High-scoring games vs weak pass D; Purdy gets Commanders.
items.implication: Prioritize Purdy start; account for PHI QB/RB absences.
